items.title: FWIW -- Jock Landale's injury listing did change.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
FWIW -- Jock Landale's injury listing did change.

From what I've heard, he had multiple issues at the same time and the toe is now the one most hampering him from playing, so they changed the listing.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
Hawks injury report for Friday's NBA Cup game against Charlotte:

Kingston Flemings (lumbar strain) is questionable.

Jock Landale (right great toe sprain) is out.

McCollum (calf), Gueye (foot), Newell (toe), Veesaar (knee) remain out.

items.title: Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.

Last season, those 4 players combined to shoot 36.1% over nearly 1,300 attempts.

Seems safe to project more shots will be falling in the future.
